question: Can a World task record connect Subject seek Object with a scoped Machine obligate Human review request while keeping arithmetic evidence, externally assumed task agreement and unresolved human review separate?

naming.World: user-defined counterpart of open; Proposed working relation, not complement, inverse or World=Universe

level: One finite task-formation calibration in a Rust research example, not an Adva self-interpreter or new stable operation
agreement: The fixture supplies an external-assumption record for one task and review action. The tag is not authentication and establishes no real person's consent. A machine proposal does not replace this input; an arithmetic certificate cannot authorize new human duties or resource contributions.
cases: main witness x=2 with matching assumed review agreement
short fuel preserves Unknown and candidates 2,3
fresh task goal4 reuses method to find x=3
machine proposal cannot serve as imported agreement
display rename preserves unchanged task binding
wrong x=1 for goal3 cannot yield a sealed native witness
checker: Existing exact integer expression, guarded evaluation, three-role formation boundary, native WitnessStoreV0 arithmetic transition and seal; agreement-origin and full-task-binding checks are separate research-local protocol rules
protected: No stable types, builtins, IR versions or CLI semantics changed
Human task obligation is distinct from native arithmetic guard obligation
Subject, Machine and Human roles remain distinct references
No source identity from a name or digest
No fabricated consent or authenticated provenance claim
Scalar witness does not close World or Universe
All task outcomes retain unresolved human review
Unknown never creates an extra-fuel duty
No unknown-syntax-building restart, automatic merge or recursive filename generation
success: Retain native arithmetic witnesses and refusal/residual records for all eight fixed groups. Successful arithmetic may produce only a scoped pending review under a matching supplied agreement; it never proves actual Human acceptance or complete World closure.
exit: Stop after the fixed cases, a discrepancy, or a resource cap. Do not extend the candidate family or invent agreement to obtain closure.
cost: Count search visits separately from verification, construction, serialization and file writes. Measure available phase/outer times and RSS; unmeasured costs remain missing. File size is not peak memory.
